h1: The “Premium+” design package — our most comprehensive design and project support

blocks.text: The “Premium+” design package — our most comprehensive design and project support

parts.html: “Premium+” is the most comprehensive design package from DUMSKAYA DESIGN for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces.
Everything included in “Premium”, plus 2 months of design supervision, furniture drawings, complete finishing material specifications, and schedules for all interior items.
Suitable for those who need a designer’s support during the renovation in addition to the concept and documentation.

A measured floor plan, a functional layout and furniture arrangement, demolition and construction plans, electrical, lighting, plumbing, ceiling, and floor plans, extended wall elevations, detail drawings and sections, specifications, and quantity calculations for the main materials.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations of each main room (up to two full rounds of revisions) and two material-selection trips with the designer.

For two months, the designer stays involved in the project: advising on design solutions, clarifying details, checking that the work matches the project, and helping out when a quick decision is needed on site.
This way, both you and the crew stick to the approved concept, and the interior keeps its integrity throughout the renovation.
A set of drawings for custom furniture: the dimensions, placement, appearance, and construction of each piece.
This is especially important for kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, built-in storage systems, wall panels, cabinets, shelving units, and other bespoke cabinet furniture.

We draw the furniture together with the finishing and electrical plans, so the alcoves, outlets, and lighting are tied to the cabinets from the start. The studio can also make the furniture from these drawings in our own workshop.
Extended specifications for finishing materials from the approved concept.
These may include flooring, ceramic tile, porcelain tile, paint, decorative coatings, wall panels, and other materials needed to bring the interior to life.
With a complete list of items, it’s easier to plan purchases.
The package also includes schedules of the main interior items.
They may cover furniture, lighting, plumbing fixtures, decorative elements, textiles, equipment, and other items specified in the project.
You see everything needed to furnish and equip the property, and preparing for implementation becomes much simpler.
The package is suitable for apartments, private houses, condos, investment properties, offices, salons, stores, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.
It is especially well suited to properties with complex architecture, a large amount of bespoke furniture, non-standard materials, complex technical solutions, and exacting standards of execution.
If you need the most complete project possible, want to make fewer decisions on your own during the renovation, and want the designer’s support during implementation.
And also if the project involves a lot of custom furniture, non-standard solutions, and complex junctions between materials, or if the property needs extensive furnishing and procurement.

The most complete design project possible: a layout with furniture arrangement, 3D visualizations, an extended set of drawings with wall elevations, detail drawings, and sections, furniture drawings, finishing material specifications, and schedules of interior items.
Plus up to two full rounds of revisions to the visualizations, two material-selection trips with the designer, and 2 months of design supervision.
€70/m²
Minimum package price: €3,500.

The final cost depends on the floor area of the property, the number of rooms, the complexity of the architectural and interior solutions, the scope of furniture documentation, and the level of project detail required.
“Premium” (€50/m²) is a detailed project with extended technical documentation, specifications, two full rounds of revisions to the visualizations, and two material-selection trips with the designer.
“Premium+” (€70/m²) adds 2 months of design supervision, furniture drawings, complete finishing material specifications, and schedules of all the main interior items.
Put simply, “Premium” prepares the project for the renovation, while “Premium+” also supports the renovation itself.

You can add a detailed renovation cost estimate, full furnishing and procurement, purchasing of individual items, and custom furniture manufacturing with delivery and installation, as well as a turnkey renovation. That way, after the design stage you continue working with a single contractor.

blocks.text: Interior design in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs residential and commercial interiors, makes custom furniture, and supports the implementation.
Our main work is in Bratislava and Vienna, and projects for other cities in Europe and the USA are handled remotely.
Choose “Premium+” if you need a full project with furniture documentation, specifications, and support during the renovation. The consultation before you order is free.
